messages:
alex_cs: FYI opened from a customer — Acme said they applied promo LAUNCH50, saw 50 trial credits then they disappeared after they re-auth'd their card. Customer asked for reinstatement and clarity on why it vanished. paste of customer: 'I entered LAUNCH50, got 50 credits, then I updated my card and my balance dropped to 0. Is this a bug?'
samir_engineer: can you drop account_id and a screenshot? quick check: sometimes billing webhook triggers a state change that clears trial credits if account becomes "paid".
alex_cs: account_id: acct_92fj. screenshot attached in thread (customer sent image). no other errors reported by them.
samir_engineer: pulling logs now. give me a sec.
samir_engineer: found events: promo_apply -> grant_credits(50) @2026-11-01T14:02Z then payment_method_update @2026-11-01T14:05Z which triggered billing-state-transition -> mark_account_active -> revoke_trial_credits per current workflow. so not a crash, it behaved per logic.
alex_cs: ugh ok. customer says they didn't expect card update to remove promo credits — they thought promo was for account irrespective of card.
billing: current policy (internal): trial/promotional credits are conditional — if an account transitions from trial->paid (explicit payment method attached + billing activated) within X window, promo auto-converts or is revoked depending on promo type. LAUNCH50 is a trial-credit that is revoked on manual billing activation to avoid double-crediting. we should verify doc copy is clear.
jordan_support: customer-facing answer: offer reinstatement as one-off? They lost credits because of payment activation, but we can grant a goodwill manual credit if approved.
ops: to grant manually we need ticket and authorizing rep. command we run in ops console:
```
ops grant-temporary-credits --acct acct_92fj --amount 50 --reason "goodwill_trial_reinstate" --expires 30d
```
please confirm and i'll queue.
alex_cs: customer wants reinstatement. i will confirm with them that they understand the policy. they agreed to a manual grant. authorizing rep: jordan_support.
jordan_support: approved. ops please proceed.
ops: queued. deploy-bot: ran action grant-temporary-credits for acct_92fj amount=50 expires=30d. ticket #CS-2026-451 created.
ops: done — balance now shows 50 credits. emailed customer and cc'd alex_cs. customer replied: 'Thanks! Appreciate the fast help.' :tada:
alex_cs: follow-up note for docs team — policy language ambiguous around card updates. filed a small docs PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/promo-credit-clarity (will link in product backlog)
samir_engineer: logging note for runtime: maybe avoid automatic revocation on simple payment_method_update events; should only revoke when subscription actually activates. filing an engineering task.
jordan_support: resolved from our side. tagging for billing to consider policy tweak.
billing: acknowledged, will propose updated wording + a safer state-machine change. assigned to billing-roadmap.
alex_cs: closing thread — customer satisfied. :white_check_mark:
